name: ZAR Supercoin
oneLiner: ZARsc is Super Money SA's cash-backed rand token on Solana; exchange exits are live, while direct app redemption awaits launch.
collateral: Rand cash in an Absa Bank current account in Super Money SA's name, supported by Moore's September 30, 2026 agreed-upon-procedures report, which expresses no assurance opinion.
pegMechanism: One ZAR per token is the issuer reference. Supported exchange sale/off-ramp is live without guaranteed price or liquidity; direct redemption within two business days is conditional on the future Supercoin App launch.

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Pharos refinement Refine02 primary-source and RPC review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Binding terms describe one-rand reserve-backed native Solana tokens, with no interest or collective-investment share. The exact Token-2022 mint creation and initializeMint transaction at slot 361067527 on 2025-08-19 establishes implementation age independently of recent exchange-listing history.
